note: BH-9439: for each member PR of a red merge-queue batch, the lane reads the jobs of at most this many prequeue-group-gate.yml runs created before the batch, newest first, to find the member's `gate (<pr>, <head40>) / gate` job (each group run's jobs are read once a tick). A member whose job is not in those runs gets a `?` gate. A value outside 1..100 is the default. Settings key lane.ci-batch-red-report.ci_batch_red_group_scan.
